  PROBLEM: The extensionless-file fallback (`tokens = spans or words`; `len(tokens) == 1`) records a prose Files bullet as a file target, e.g. "- Give the `build` job more time" records `build`. gemini describes the recorded token as a prose word such as "Give" or "the".
  WHY: The recorded token fails `HEAL_RG_WORKFLOW_PATH_RE` (line 655), so the function returns False and plan.yml auto-posts `/approved` for a timeout-only plan, the shape this gate exists to hold. All reviewers rated it MAJOR. Suggested fix: `len(words) == 1`.

  PROBLEM: The rest of every path bullet is appended to `other` (in_context=False) and scanned as plan text, including companion bullets (tests/**, changelog.d/*.md, agents.d/*.md). The companion filter at line 650 cleans only `files`, so identifiers in a companion description (e.g. `PYTEST_ADDOPTS`, `CI_JOB_NAME`, `TIMEOUT_EXPIRED`) are still scanned.
  WHY: The identifier check at lines 677-679 returns False, so a timeout-only plan bypasses the `budget_only_plan` hold and is auto-approved. This reopens the companion escape that test_regression_named_test_file_does_not_lift_the_budget_hold was meant to close. All reviewers rated it MAJOR; confidence ranged 3-4. Suggested fix: treat companion bullet text as context, or skip it from `other`, using HEAL_RG_COMPANION_PATH_RE.
